Sync Plaud
Install or enable the official Plaud app to sync your recorder.
Check whether your phone can see the recorder. These checks do not pair, read recordings, or upload. For automatic transfer while connected, use the official Plaud app.
Open official Plaud app
Check USB connection
USB: this phone does not expose USB host diagnostics.
USB: no peripheral detected. This only checks accessories plugged into this phone, not its cable to a computer.
USB: a peripheral is visible, but it did not expose a mass-storage interface.
USB: a mass-storage interface is visible. Check the Android Files app to see whether it is mounted and contains recordings from your Note.
Check nearby Bluetooth
Bluetooth: keep the phone unlocked, wake the recorder, and scan for nearby advertisements.
Bluetooth: this check requires Android 12 or newer.
Bluetooth: allow Nearby devices to run this check.
Bluetooth: turn it on, then try again. This phone must support Bluetooth LE.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to scan for nearby devices.
Bluetooth: scanning for up to 20 seconds…
Bluetooth is back on. Looking for the same recorder…
Found the candidate recorder again. A scan result does not grant access.
The previous candidate did not appear in the new scan. No connection was attempted.
Bluetooth: found an advertisement with a Plaud name. This does not verify the recorder model, pairing, or recording access.
Bluetooth: found the advertised service used by Plaud. This does not verify the recorder model or recording access.
Bluetooth: found a Nordic radio advertisement, but no Plaud name or service. Many devices use this radio; this does not identify your Note.
Bluetooth: nearby devices were seen, but none advertised a Plaud name or service. The recorder may be asleep or already connected.
Bluetooth: no nearby advertisements were delivered. Keep the phone unlocked, wake the recorder and try again.
Bluetooth: the scan could not run. Check Bluetooth and Nearby devices permission, then retry.
Direct connection unavailable: Localplaud does not have supported recorder authorization.
Bluetooth is off. No direct connection.
Android denied Bluetooth access. Check Nearby devices permission, then authorize a new connection.
Waiting for the recorder…
Waiting to retry the Bluetooth scan…
Wait for the scan cooldown to end before rescanning.
Ready to rescan for the same recorder.
Could not save the scan budget. No further scans will start.
Another screen is tracking a different recorder. Refresh to show its scan status.
Scan status updated. No rescan is pending.
Refresh scan status
Rescan
Waiting for the other screen to release this recorder connection…
Opening an authorized connection…
Bluetooth services changed. Checking them again…
Authorized connection active.
Disconnected. Retrying automatically…
Upload test only. This does not read audio from a Plaud recorder.
Authorize test uploads
Open browser
Comparison code: %1$s. Only approve if the browser shows the same code and your intended account.
No browser can open the upload approval page.
Check approval and upload queued audio
Checking upload approval and queued audio…
No approval available yet. Approve the request in the browser, or start a new request if it has expired.
Upload permission expired or was revoked. Authorize again; unsent audio stays on this phone.
Workspace upload approved. No recordings are queued on this phone.
The workspace confirmed %1$d upload(s).
Uploaded: %1$d. Retained for retry: %2$d. Retained for review: %3$d. Unreadable entries: %4$d. Unconfirmed audio stays on this phone.
Could not finish the upload check. Any unconfirmed audio stays on this phone.
Android is blocking this app from using the default network. Browser approval may still open, but the app may be unable to claim approval or send queued recordings.
